stage: D4-A5-R3 — Continuation Lineage and End-to-End Accounting Repair
starting_commit_message: D4-A5-R2 repair continuation freeze and accounting contract

defect_a_phase_p_phase_r_lineage_mismatc.finding: Continuation Phase P wrote exposure['r2_freeze_head'] from the start preflight, but Phase R still read exposure.get('r1_freeze_head') and passed that stale field to the continuation plan-freeze gate: a clean R2/R3 freeze -> Phase P -> 7 plans -> plan freeze -> Phase R would hard-fail on a missing r1_freeze_head.
defect_a_phase_p_phase_r_lineage_mismatc.repair: Phase P now freezes continuation_implementation_freeze_head from the shared preflight receipt; the plan-freeze gate and Phase R consume the frozen continuation lineage and never a stale historical r1_freeze_head.

defect_b_stale_r1_provenance_downstream.finding: Continuation Phase-R raw artifacts and evaluator/result provenance still used r1_freeze_head as if it were the current continuation implementation freeze.
defect_b_stale_r1_provenance_downstream.repair: One unambiguous lineage vocabulary (historical_a5_starting_head, historical_a5_executor_freeze_head, historical_a5_stop_head, historical_r1_head, historical_r2_head, continuation_implementation_freeze_head, continuation_plan_freeze_head, continuation_raw_freeze_head) is used by the committed manifest, Phase-P raw-plans provenance, Phase-R raw-results provenance and authority block, and evaluator/result provenance. Historical R1/R2 heads are never collapsed into the current implementation-freeze field.

defect_c_accounting_only_wired_to_phase_.finding: apply_continuation_accounting updated Analyzer acquisition accounting but not Phase-R retrieval accounting.
defect_c_accounting_only_wired_to_phase_.repair: Every completed retrieval cell feeds its ACTUAL recorded stats (embedding calls, reranker calls, retrieval provider attempts, known token usage) into the same deterministic helper; cumulative values are recomputed as historical + continuation. The expected 14/14 protocol outcome must be derived from actual cell records, never assumed.

defect_d_provider_failure_unknown_accoun.finding: Per-slot failure receipts could say provider attempts = unknown while the manifest aggregate effectively added numeric zero; the logical-call semantics for failed acquisitions were unset.
defect_d_provider_failure_unknown_accoun.repair: Manifest accounting gains explicit unknown_provider_attempt_events and unknown_token_usage_events dimensions (cumulative unknown = historical unknowns + continuation unknowns). Frozen logical-call semantics: a continuation Analyzer acquisition that is actually invoked but terminates in a provider exception counts as ONE logical Analyzer acquisition; provider/internal attempts remain a separate dimension (known integer or unknown); no retry (max_retries = 0, max_provider_attempts_per_case = 1 unchanged).

r3_continuation_implementation_freeze.commit_message: D4-A5-R3 repair continuation lineage and end-to-end accounting
r3_continuation_implementation_freeze.mechanism: containing-commit contract: the R3 commit forward-updates the committed continuation manifest; future continuation start requires HEAD == the R3 freeze commit with the exact message, direct parent = the R2 HEAD, the manifest committed at HEAD, clean worktree/index, the runner at HEAD being the frozen R3 runner, and historical/production paths unchanged; no descendant is dynamically accepted; no hash inventories or cryptographic sealing

lineage_vocabulary.continuation_implementation_freeze_head: the R3 freeze commit (recorded at Phase P start from the shared preflight receipt)
lineage_vocabulary.continuation_plan_freeze_head: the continuation plan-freeze commit (direct child of the R3 freeze)
lineage_vocabulary.continuation_raw_freeze_head: the continuation raw-freeze commit (direct child of the plan-freeze commit)

future_execution_lineage: continuation plan-freeze commit (D4-A5 continuation freeze prospective shared plans)
continuation raw-freeze commit (D4-A5 continuation freeze paired raw retirement results)
continuation closeout commit (D4-A5 continuation close controlled retirement validation)

required: exact 7-case cohort with completed provenance-gated plans
R3->plan-freeze diff limited to the frozen plan-acquisition artifacts (continuation manifest + raw plans)

phase_r_preflight.function: verify_phase_r_preflight (shared by the CLI-reachable execution path and focused tests)

end_to_end_accounting_contract.derivation_rule: cell/slot accounting updates come from ACTUAL recorded receipts; totals are never assumed from the protocol; unknown components stay explicit
end_to_end_accounting_contract.double_counting_prevention: terminal slot/cell status transitions gate re-application; reload/recompute leaves counters stable; cumulative is a deterministic function of historical + continuation state

scientific_contract_unchanged.metrics_thresholds: six primary metrics, frozen tolerances, MRR diagnostic-only

forward_only_audit_note: R2 successfully repaired the continuation bootstrap boundary, but the post-plan continuation lineage and end-to-end accounting contract remained incomplete; R3 closes those defects without rewriting R1/R2 records.
